      "observed_facts": [
        "The episode included blocked navigation results and later accepted movement with measurable progress.",
        "The final robot pose was outside the goal region, with no goal dwell; sampled box displacement was negligible.",
        "The supplied taxonomy detected none of the supported primary behavior families for this episode."
      ],
      "leading_hypothesis": "This is a goal noncompletion without a measured primary-family diagnosis; the recorded blocks may have been transient rather than a persistent obstacle interference pattern.",
      "alternative_explanation": "The episode may have ended outside the goal after staging and movement progress without a terminal stall.",
      "uncertainty": "The outcome and incidental knee-to-box contact do not establish a box-caused failure or physical manipulation limitation.",
      "next_test_implication": "A distinguishing observation would be repeated accepted blocked/no_path results in the recent window, a nearby static obstacle, and a qualifying terminal stall—not merely another outside-goal ending."
    },
    {

      "observed_outcome": "FAIL",
      "observation_versions": [0, 1, 6, 7
		],
      "observed_facts": [
        "Some navigation requests were blocked, while other accepted navigation and movement requests produced measurable progress.",
        "A staging target was reached outside the goal; the final goal distance was about 0.77 m with zero dwell.",
        "The measured terminal window was not stalled, and the detector did not report goal_occupied, obstacle_interference, or another supported primary family."
      ],
      "leading_hypothesis": "The failure is consistent with incomplete final approach after mixed progress and blocks, rather than a demonstrated persistent blockage.",
      "alternative_explanation": "The blocked requests may have been transient, with subsequent movement still making progress; no_path or global unreachability is not established.",

      "leading_hypothesis": "This episode establishes a fall observation alongside a distinct human-proxy exposure observation, but neither identifies the cause of the fall.",
